svg.title: 2048 Siege: the 28 fusion pets as 28 animals, solid silhouettes (the generation contracts)
svg.desc: Sheet cells start at x = 20 + col*172, y = 50 + row*170 (7 columns). Each creature sits in a 120x120 box, ground at y = 104, facing left (profile), or symmetric (front / spread). The small copy beside each is the 40 px on-screen check. Symbol ids are sil-<a>-<b> for the fusion key a+b. Only circle, ellipse (rotate), polygon, M/L/C/Z paths and stroked paths are used, so tools/make-contracts.py (the foe rasteriser) can turn them into contracts.
svg.text: 2048 Siege: the 28 fusion pets as 28 animals (solid silhouettes, 120 px box, 40 px check)
